title: The Pour V3 complete faucet module

parts.name: Industrial / Sculpted hybrid full faucet body

style_comparison.hybrid_half_plane: X=0; Industrial X<0, Sculpted X>0 below Z67.5; complete Industrial upper remains
style_comparison.common_mounting_cavities: Both source halves retain the same native plate sockets and donor envelope; only exterior style differs.

binary_stl_join.scope: Coplanar center-join STL reconstruction only; analytic CAD and non-planar source faces unchanged.

notes.scope: Intentional hybrid reference foot. Both styles use one object-wide print generator; no production-faucet or matched independent-generator claim.

notes.display_pose: Actual source nominal seated elastic model; the relaxed manufacturing body is separate and must elastically spread on installation.

seated_display.scope: Nominal source elastic seated model in faucet frame; separately meshed from relaxed manufacturing model.

parts.name: Source mounting plate with rooted nominal donor mate

manufacturing_frame.authority: hardware/printed-parts/faucet/industrial/industrial_faucet.py#build_above_counter_plate; reference adaptation retains native plate-down direction

notes.adaptation: Printed dimensional donor reference rooted into the source above-counter plate. Inactive shank ends at plate underside Z−4; above-counter envelope is retained. Port moved +0.125 mm in Y to source tube axis +8.875. Added nominal Ø2.4 plunger rod and observed-diameter transverse bar.
notes.retention_scope: Source lever channel/ledges around nominal bar, source neck/tube bay and native M3 plate/base fastening. Modeled alignment only; physical friction, insertion, movement and load untested.

parts.name: Source above-counter gasket with native-axis fastener holes

notes.adaptation: Three Ø3.9 through-perforations on the unchanged source plate/base M3 axes for the cabinet fastener stack; all other source gasket lands retain their geometry.
notes.scope: Two-millimetre source gasket with declared cabinet-joint perforations. Compression, sealing and load acceptance do not transfer to this unprinted stack.

notes.assembly_alignment: Modeled dimensional donor alignment; source measured installed transform is null. Lever source geometry is untouched.

notes.scope: Source elastic sealing geometry on a printed nominal port. Physical seal, friction and capture are untested.

notes.retention: Source full organizer on actual tube bundle inside cabinet; final routing and tube-end capture belong to the counter module.

notes.scope: Source Ø6.68 horizontal bore. PETG/0.2 nozzle calibration does not establish PET-GF bore behavior. Final closed-end tube routing retains the collar.
